notes.note: Reviewed configured-before-started launch ordering observed in the live Codex check. The metadata fold now accumulates ordered observed fields so Station's later partial session.started fact cannot erase adapter-reported native binding. The scripted production-service handoff fixture reproduced the failure (2 native-return variants failed) and passes all 4 after the fix; independent source review found no concrete regression. Existing bounded-context and observed-identity claims remain accurate. This repairs binding discovery; full live cross-provider return remains blocked by Claude weekly quota and is not claimed.
